questions.answer: Based on this site's article on the 40-word rule, start each section with a question-style H2 or H3 that matches what users actually ask, then write a direct answer block of 40 to 60 words right after it, beginning with the subject and a verb and skipping preamble [2]. Expand with supporting evidence, examples, or data afterward, since that part can be longer than the answer block [2]. Joe's guidance also favors expert-attributed statistics in this structure [2]. questions.answer: A GEO strategy needs technical SEO as its base. Without it, AI systems may not be able to crawl your content, and discovered pages may not be indexed for AI retrieval [2]. The essentials include making sure AI crawlers can reach your pages, that important content renders in the HTML, and that pages are indexed [3]. Joe's AEO program also covers AI crawler rules, server-rendered content, llms.txt, page speed, and schema markup [4]. Fast loading, mobile optimization, and clean site architecture also count as GEO essentials [7]. For a conversation about this work, see [the contact page](/contact/).

ChatGPT tends to cite the page that most directly and specifically answers the question, not the best-known site on the topic, so a clearly structured page can beat a vague one [2]. Joe's guidance is to start with content quality and structure, since that helps across AI platforms, and then build a consistent brand presence for ChatGPT [6].
